summary: Reliance Global Group filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, disclosing a Sixth Amendment to its Master Credit Agreement with Oak Street Funding LLC, which approved the sale of wholly owned subsidiary Southwestern Montana Insurance Center, LLC (SMI). Oak Street agreed to apply 50% of the transaction proceeds, totaling $1,207,324.67, to Loan ID 121393 rather than requiring full repayment, allowing the Company to retain the balance. Oak Street will release SMI as a Borrower and release its security interests and liens on SMI's assets, subject to a $15,000 amendment fee and customary conditions precedent. Guarantors, including Chairman and CEO Ezra S. Beyman, delivered reaffirmations of credit documents. Watch for completion risk and use of retained proceeds.
